observations: Photo 0 shows a white sewing machine with a front handwheel/arm area and a blue control panel; brand text “TOYOTA” is visible on the left side.
Photo 0 shows the words “FLOURISHING JOY” printed/overlaid on the image (appears as watermark/text, not necessarily the machine model).
Photo 1 shows the same sewing machine from a wider angle; “TOYOTA” is again visible on the left side.
No clear model number/serial number is readable in either photo.
The machine appears to be a tabletop (top-loading/portable) sewing machine; no full table base is shown beyond the tabletop surface.

claims.claim: Preloved sewing table top machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: Photos show a tabletop sewing machine; condition appears used/preloved (wear/dust), though exact usage history is not provable from photos.
Negotiability is not shown in photos; only seller text.

risks.risk: Whether the machine is working properly (motor, speed control, stitching, needle timing). Photos cannot confirm operation.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine sewing a straight line on fabric (with needle moving) plus a close-up of the stitch result.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs service/doesn’t sew).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (needle, bobbin, presser foot, power cable, foot pedal) or incorrect parts.
risks.proof: A clear photo laid out showing all included items: power cable, foot pedal (if any), needles, bobbins, presser feet, and manual (if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst case: buyer may need to buy missing parts).

risks.risk: Model/variant mismatch affecting value (different Toyota sewing machine models have different capabilities).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the model plate/label and serial number (usually on the side/back/bottom).
risks.if_unproven: Price it at the lowest comparable Toyota tabletop sewing machine value without knowing the exact model.

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage or mechanical wear not obvious in photos (cracks, bent needle bar, worn gears).
risks.proof: Photos of the underside/bottom, needle area, and any visible wear points; plus a video showing smooth handwheel movement.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as potentially worn (worst case: requires maintenance).

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing (straight stitch) on fabric, showing the needle moving and the stitch quality.
Close-up photo of the model plate/serial number label (side/back/bottom).
Photos of included accessories: power cable, foot pedal (if present), needles, bobbins, presser feet.
response.reason: The photos identify it as a Toyota tabletop sewing machine, but they don’t prove it works or reveal the exact model/accessories—those factors strongly affect the price. Request a sewing test video and a clear model/serial label.
